comments.value: This is awesome feedback! With that in mind, mega-posts in this style don't work too well in the Canny format. Please split separate suggestions into their own posts, as noted here: http://bit.ly/vrchat-feature-requests

details:
Pardon me for putting a lot of ideas under one umbrella (again), but they're all closely related by the same system and goal of making it easier to manage and parse huge friend lists.

My excuse is that it's still one request: Improve the social menu!

If mods have to close this because it's a bunch of different ideas, please tell me that so I can just post the separate cannies.

⠀

⠀
Old post below:

⠀
𝗦𝘂𝗴𝗴𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗵𝗲𝗹𝗽 𝗵𝘂𝗴𝗲 𝗳𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁:

⠀
1. 𝙐𝙣𝙡𝙞𝙢𝙞𝙩 "𝙁𝙧𝙞𝙚𝙣𝙙 𝙂𝙧𝙤𝙪𝙥𝙨"

The friend grouping system is a nice start, but VRChat is a huge social platform, just like Steam or Discord.

Three groups of 32 is just not enough friend list management for me, there are LOTS of people I want to keep up with and like to visit.

I suggest more or less copying something tried and true that works... like Steam!

Steam allows you to create as many "groups" as you want (instead of just 3), and you can add as many friends as you want to any group.

You can also put one friend into multiple groups (which you can't in VRChat atm). There are cases for this!

To accomodate this change, because it'd get messy if you could create as many groups as you want, we should be able to minimize the UI for group lists even further by hiding thumbnails. An example image has been provided in the attachments.

----

2. 𝙁𝙞𝙡𝙩𝙚𝙧/𝙎o𝙧𝙩 𝙛𝙧𝙞𝙚𝙣𝙙𝙨 𝙡𝙞𝙨𝙩 𝙗𝙖𝙨𝙚𝙙 𝙤𝙣 𝙎𝙩𝙖𝙩𝙪𝙨, 𝙒𝙤𝙧𝙡𝙙 𝙋𝙪𝙗𝙡𝙞𝙘𝙞𝙩𝙮, 𝙇𝙖𝙨𝙩 𝙊𝙣𝙡𝙞𝙣𝙚, 𝙍𝙚𝙘𝙚𝙣𝙩𝙡𝙮 𝙈𝙚𝙩, 𝙚𝙩𝙘...

If I could just hide everyone who's in a Private World without Join Me Status, that would drastically lower the number of names I have to scroll through just while looking at who's online.

And if I want to specifically hunt down random people in private worlds, it'd be easier if I could sort them to all be in a row.

Recently Met sorting would allow you to sort based on ... how recently you last met someone. For example, you could find the person you haven't seen for the longest time much easier with this type of sort.

There's probably other good criteria for sorting and filtering friends. If you can think of any, please comment!

----

3. 𝙋𝙧𝙞𝙫𝙖𝙩𝙚 𝙒𝙤𝙧𝙡𝙙 𝙄𝙘𝙤𝙣 𝙞𝙣 𝙎𝙤𝙘𝙞𝙖𝙡 𝙈𝙚𝙣𝙪

In my example image for minimizing Group Tabs, I also provided an example for how it could look if the thumbnail showed whether or not friends are in a Private World.

It's been requested before and would fit nicely with a Social Menu UI upgrade.
https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/show-if-friends-are-in-private-world-in-social-menu

----

⠀
𝗦𝘂𝗴𝗴𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗻𝗰𝘆 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗶𝗻𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗰𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗿:

⠀
4. 𝘿𝙤𝙣'𝙩 𝙨𝙝𝙤𝙬 𝙛𝙧𝙞𝙚𝙣𝙙𝙨 𝙞𝙣 𝙨𝙤𝙢𝙚𝙤𝙣𝙚 𝙚𝙡𝙨𝙚'𝙨 "𝙁𝙧𝙞𝙚𝙣𝙙𝙨-𝙊𝙣𝙡𝙮 𝙒𝙤𝙧𝙡𝙙" 𝙖𝙨 𝙗𝙚𝙞𝙣𝙜 "𝙄𝙣 𝙖 𝙋𝙧𝙞𝙫𝙖𝙩𝙚 𝙒𝙤𝙧𝙡𝙙", 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙡𝙚𝙩 𝙪𝙨 𝙛𝙧𝙞𝙚𝙣𝙙 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙤𝙬𝙣𝙚𝙧 𝙤𝙛 𝙩𝙝𝙖𝙩 𝙞𝙣𝙨𝙩𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙚.

It's confusing and misleading that my friends appear in "Private Worlds" when they are actually in the Friends-Only instance of someone you don't have befriended.

It's especially bad if that friend has the Join Me status, because you will expect it to automatically accept your join request, only to not actually get an invite because they weren't truly in a private world.

It's cumbersome to send a request for an invite to a friend who's in a Friends-Only world, where my friend then has to ask the instance owner to find my username and friend request me, or somehow tell me who to send a friend request to.

It'd be much simpler if I could just send a friend request to that instance owner directly. The instance owner can then sort out with my friend about why he just got a random friend request.

Perhaps it doesn't even need to be a friend request - let me send a join request to the instance owner without having to friend them. This would make Friends-Only seem similar to how private worlds already are, but instead of requesting the invites from your friends, you're requesting off of instance owners and don't necessarily have to befriend them.

----

5. 𝙎𝙡𝙚𝙚𝙥 𝙎𝙩𝙖𝙩𝙪𝙨 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝘼𝙪𝙩𝙤-𝙨𝙚𝙩𝙩𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝘼𝙁𝙆 𝙎𝙩𝙖𝙩𝙪𝙨.

Add a Sleep status that can't be manually set, but is automatically set after 2 hours of being inactive. I'll let the devs think about the criteria for this. In Desktop it's obvious. In VR this may be a little intesting.

Also, automatically set people to AFK after 5 minutes of inactivity.

----

6. 𝙄𝙣𝙫𝙞𝙨𝙞𝙗𝙡𝙚 𝙎𝙩𝙖𝙩𝙪𝙨 / 𝘼𝙥𝙥𝙚𝙖𝙧 𝙊𝙛𝙛𝙡𝙞𝙣𝙚

https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/add-a-stealth-mode-to-allow-people-to-appear-offline

----

7. 𝙁𝙞𝙭 "𝘽𝙪𝙨𝙮" 𝙨𝙩𝙖𝙩𝙪𝙨 𝙨𝙤 𝙥𝙚𝙤𝙥𝙡𝙚 𝙘𝙖𝙣𝙣𝙤𝙩 𝙧𝙚𝙦𝙪𝙚𝙨𝙩 𝙞𝙣𝙫𝙞𝙩𝙚𝙨 𝙤𝙣 𝙮𝙤𝙪.

This is a fix, not a feature request, because it's redundant to be able to send invite requests to people who are set to Busy.

----

8. 𝙀𝙭𝙩𝙚𝙣𝙙 "𝘽𝙪𝙨𝙮" 𝙨𝙩𝙖𝙩𝙪𝙨 𝙩𝙤 𝙥𝙧𝙚𝙫𝙚𝙣𝙩 𝙥𝙚𝙤𝙥𝙡𝙚 𝙛𝙧𝙤𝙢 𝙟𝙤𝙞𝙣𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙤𝙣 𝙮𝙤𝙪 𝙙𝙞𝙧𝙚𝙘𝙩𝙡𝙮 𝙚𝙫𝙚𝙣 𝙞𝙛 𝙮𝙤𝙪'𝙧𝙚 𝙞𝙣 𝙖 𝙣𝙤𝙧𝙢𝙖𝙡𝙡𝙮 𝙟𝙤𝙞𝙣𝙖𝙗𝙡𝙚 𝙞𝙣𝙨𝙩𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙚 (𝙡𝙞𝙠𝙚 𝙖 𝙋𝙪𝙗𝙡𝙞𝙘 𝙬𝙤𝙧𝙡𝙙).

This would be functionally the same as an "Invisible Status", except you are still broadcasting that you're online.

----

9. 𝙁𝙧𝙞𝙚𝙣𝙙 𝙊𝙣𝙡𝙞𝙣𝙚 𝙉𝙤𝙩𝙞𝙛𝙞𝙘𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣

Steam has something like this, where we can turn on a notification that tells me when a friend comes online. It can be set on a per-friend basis.

We can already sort of do this by favoriting someone and just constantly checking our friend list, so why not automate this and save anyone who may have the OCD to constantly check their friend list.

It may be worthwhile to consider a "Friend Now-Joinable" Notification that plays a small noise when the friend moves to a joinable instance, incase they finally jumped out of that busy-status private world after half a day.
title: Major Friends List Improvements. (Hi, I have 1505 friends.)
